assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: panoramic editorial illustration for a heating proposal PDF, not a customer's actual installation. Create a photorealistic wide 3:1 photograph of a modest elegant Italian utility room with a single closed, unbranded white wall mounted condensing boiler in the CENTER. Show the ENTIRE appliance with generous margins around it; it occupies only the central 35% of image height so a center panoramic crop preserves its top and bottom. A short enclosed flue enters the wall behind it, service connections hidden by a plain removable matching cover immediately beneath; no exposed wiring or procedural demonstration. Warm neutral plaster wall and light stone flooring, soft natural light, natural material grain. Wide composition, level camera, no people, no tools, no diagrams, no text, no logos, no watermark. The appliance must be recognizable and entirely visible, with its whole silhouette in the middle half of the frame vertically.
